slides.header: Oregon's dry-season roofing window is open right now.

slides.body: Dry decks, long days, and shingles sealing fast in the warmth. June through October is roofing's main season here for a reason.
Calendars fill up, especially late summer when homeowners start doing pre-winter math. The earlier the conversation starts, the better the slot you get.
Every storm season a failing roof absorbs adds moisture damage that compounds quietly. Decking rot doesn't pause for your preferred season.
There is no cheapest month. Pricing follows scope and materials, not the calendar. Off-season flexibility buys scheduling ease, not a discount.
Oregon winters deal dry stretches, and an experienced local crew sequences work around them. For a roof that shouldn't wait, winter done right beats hoping.
